scope: Optional PROFILE observations; no hardware starvation or compatibility result inferred

enablement.selector: Existing PROFILE only, using the same admitted polling fast lane as NORMAL
enablement.image_gate: Exact 2143652-byte image, load 8c010000 and complete digest before fixed Evolution stack reads
enablement.report: Existing B plus both triggers gesture starts the bounded capture window; its existing timed/pair-count stop reports retained private state

measurement.timing: Existing validated owner TMU0 samples at C-body begin/end; 781250 ticks per second only under the admitted clock profile
measurement.entry: Actual hardware timing registers, scanline, TMU0 sample, raw INTEVT, SDK counter, and conditionally validated interrupted context
measurement.exit: Actual hardware timing registers and scanline with the existing endpoint TMU0 sample
measurement.history: Last sixteen completed hook records; private bounded ring, with independent valid/wait/wrap counters

flags.1: Both clock samples valid and elapsed interval admitted
flags.4: Entry/exit SPG_LOAD, SPG_VBLANK_INT and SPG_CONTROL unchanged
flags.8: Exact SDK caller chain and interrupted PR/SPC/SSR reads validated
flags.16: Validated interrupted SPC is in the exact-zero polling loop, or its getter with the second-phase return PR
flags.32: Valid unchanged-video sample has nonzero entry/exit scanlines and entry greater than exit; observed C-body interval crosses line zero

measurement.interpretation: Wrap is independent of wait: require both flags 16 and 32 to associate an observed crossing with the interrupted exact-zero wait
limits: C-body samples include observer overhead and exclude portions of the gateway and original IRQ handler
A PROFILE run does not establish identical timing in NORMAL
Raw INTEVT can reflect a nested interrupt and is not asserted to identify the unwound frame
The record's timing registers are actual active hardware values, not pending mode-setter shadow parameters

unwind.frame_pointer: Original gateway frame f, read through its inherited U0/P1/P2 alias; never force a P2 alias for potentially dirty P1 stack words
unwind.bounds: Aligned full 460-byte submit or 400-byte completion span in SDK RAM; physically disjoint from the entire owned lease including its 32-byte chunk header
unwind.generic_frame_derivation: Seven saved control/integer-special words (28), R14 through R0 (60), SR/FPUL/FPSCR (12), both sixteen-word FR banks (128)
unwind.shared_stack_limit: Both generic dispatchers use the same frame layout, but the shared-stack frame base is an IRQ-stack pointer, not necessarily the interrupted owner SP
unwind.failure: Bad bounds, aliases, markers, reads, clocks or changed video invalidate observation only; no VMU or storage acceptance predicate changes

host_validation.profile_fast_finish: Existing gesture, four clock samples per pair, shared successful completion, and explicit fast/full report-counter assertions pass
